title: Feeds status
description: Output of `feeds status`: what the offline KEV and EPSS cache holds.

kev.description: Present with entries, catalog_version, date_released when KEV data is imported

epss.description: Present with scores, model_version, score_date when EPSS data is imported

sboms.description: Present when the SBOM cache (feeds import sbom) exists

vex.description: Present when the VEX cache (feeds import vex) exists
